source_caption:
One of Them Days (2025) follows best friends Dreux and Alyssa, two roommates whose already difficult day turns into complete chaos when Alyssa discovers that her boyfriend has secretly spent their rent money.
With their home at risk and the clock running out, Dreux and Alyssa have to figure out how to get the money together before they lose their apartment. What follows is a wild journey through one ridiculous situation after another as the two friends try every possible way to solve their problem.
As the day gets more complicated, their friendship is tested by stress, arguments, unexpected setbacks, and the pressure of simply trying to survive. Even when everything seems to be falling apart, they continue pushing forward together.
The movie explores themes of friendship, loyalty, financial struggles, independence, and resilience, while turning everyday problems into exaggerated and hilarious situations.
What makes One of Them Days entertaining is the chemistry between Dreux and Alyssa. Their personalities constantly clash, but their friendship keeps them moving forward even when nothing goes according to plan.
💬 When everything goes wrong in one day, you better have a friend who won't leave you behind.

source_details.synopsis: One of Them Days is a 2025 American buddy comedy film directed by Lawrence Lamont and written by Syreeta Singleton, both in their feature film debuts. The film stars Keke Palmer and SZA (in her film debut) as two friends who must scramble to find rent money after one of their boyfriends blows through it. It was filmed in July 2024 and released in the United States and Canada by Sony Pictures Releasing on January 17, 2025. One of Them Days was a critical and commercial success, grossing over $51 million on a budget of $14 million. A sequel is in early development.
